services.desc: Take a relaxing cruise around the bay and enjoy watching our local wildlife such as dolphins, osprey, bald eagles, rays, and many others. Water is provided, guests are welcome to bring any additional beverages or snacks. One of the most unique experiences along 30A. The tour begins by cruising around the bay learning about the wildlife and ecology of the area. We then stop along the pristine coastline where you will have the chance to explore the shallows on your own.
